source_text: In contrast, female genital cutting (FGC) involves intentional alteration or injury to the clitoris, labia minora, and sometimes labia majora, often without anesthesia and using rudimentary tools, resulting in the partial or total excision of erogenous tissue essential for sexual sensation. [95]
